# Space Journey timing

<!-- GENERATED by docs/journey/tools/timing-doc.mjs from src/components/sections/spacejourney/timing.ts. Do not edit by
hand: change timing.ts and run `node docs/journey/tools/timing-doc.mjs`. -->

The page rests only at three stops: **hero → section2 → appdesign**. The first scroll intent at a stop (wheel,
trackpad, swipe, ArrowDown / PageDown / Space / End, or the reverse keys) starts a transition, which then plays by time
to the end on its own. Input during a transition is ignored. Going back plays the same timeline in reverse.

All times are seconds from the start of **that** transition. Rows are sorted by start time.

| transition | from → to | length | notes |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **A** | hero → section2 | 4.00 s | hands touch at 3.00 s (no hold before it), screen fully smoke at 3.00 s |
| **B** | section2 → appdesign | 4.25 s | flash peak (`showcase.play()`) at 3.60 s |
| A reversed | section2 → hero | 2.67 s | same timeline backwards × 1.5 |
| B reversed | appdesign → section2 | 2.83 s | same timeline backwards × 1.5; `showcase.reset()` at the flash |

## Global knobs (`TIMING.global`)

| key | value | meaning |
|---|---:|---|
| `global.reverseSpeed` | 1.5 | reverse transitions play this many times faster than forwards (1 = same speed) |
| `global.arrivalCooldown` | 0.40 s | after arriving at a stop, intents in this window are ignored (and use up their gesture) |
| `global.inputQuietGap` | 0.20 s | input silence that separates two gestures; a trackpad fling + its inertia is one gesture and can start only one transition |
| `global.tolerance` | 10 px | wheel / finger travel before an intent counts (GSAP Observer) |
| `global.flashHold` | 0.15 s | screen stays white after the flash peak (= `B.whiteHold` duration) |
| `global.flashFade` | 0.50 s | the white fades off the phone showcase (= `B.whiteFade` duration) |

The showcase's own automatic sequence (phone feed, heart tap, side phones, loops) starts at `B.flashPeak` and keeps
running after arrival; its timings are in `src/components/sections/phoneshowcase/controller.ts` (`T`).

## How to change a timing

1. Open `src/components/sections/spacejourney/timing.ts` and edit the beat's `start`, `dur` or `ease`
   (any [GSAP ease name](https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Eases)). Starts are seconds from the start of that transition.
   To lengthen a transition, also move its `arrival` (a beat that runs past `arrival` extends the transition and
   logs a console warning). The flash hold and fade are `FLASH_HOLD` / `FLASH_FADE` at the top of the file.
2. Save; the dev server reloads. Open `/?journey=debug` to review: the overlay shows the stop, the transition, the
   time in seconds and the beats active at that moment. **P** pauses, **[** / **]** step 0.1 s back / forward while
   paused, **R** replays the current transition, **1 / 2 / 3** jump to hero / section2 / appdesign.
3. Run `node docs/journey/tools/timing-doc.mjs` to regenerate this table.
4. For a phone-only change, add an override in `TIMING.mobile`, e.g. `mobile: { A: { cameraRush: { dur: 0.7 } }, B: {} }`.

Things that must stay together: `A.approach` must end when `A.cameraRush` ends (hands touch = screen fully
smoke; journey.ts warns in the console if they drift apart), and `A.gradientIn` should start then.
`A.idleCorrection`, `A.cameraRush` and `A.cameraCentre` start together. `B.flashIn` should end at
`B.flashPeak`, which is where `B.whiteHold` starts.

The figures' idle spacewalk motion never pauses during A: during `A.idleCorrection` its live effect on the two
hands and on the chest window is folded into the right figure's position and the camera target (pure maths from
`rig.json`, see `posePoint` in `src/components/space/astronaut.ts`), so they still meet exactly. The idle only
stops while act 1 is hidden (from the end of `A.gradientIn`), and restarts when going back.

`glide(k)` (used by `A.approach`) is our own ease (`EASES` in timing.ts): it starts from rest, covers most of
the way early, then keeps gliding in at a slowly falling speed that never stops before the end. Larger `k` = more
of the way covered early.
